lead_headline: One restaurant lead detected today (flat from Wednesday), foreclosure filings hit 60 this week but no properties exceed $4M threshold, reputation surges to 77 weekly mentions

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead today: Good Girl Cafe & Bookstore (Rosedale) — romance bookstore/coffee hybrid prepping to open South Broadway. Week holds at 27 openings, 15 closures.

liquor.blurb: 5 new applications today: The Mulligan Room tavern (Broadway), Villa Park Liquors (West Colfax already active), Wide Right (Curtis transfer), Sunny's hotel/restaurant (W 44th), DIA Korean BBQ (airport). 15 status changes led by NoName Grill, White Diamond Events, 7-Eleven Evans clearing delinquencies; Pints Pub, Bowls by Ko, Holey Moley drop to delinquent. Runway & Rye Lounge airport permit activates. Week slows to 10 applications — down 98% from prior week's anomalous 424 as backlog fully clears.

reputation.blurb: 2 mentions today: federal agency public input story (Reddit), IMAX 70mm projector restoration at UA Colorado Center (Instagram). Week surges to 77 mentions across 12 sources — up 22% from prior week's 63 and reversing four-week decline. Instagram dominates at 31 citations, Reddit 13, Denver Post 11, Facebook 8. IMAX repair story, Mayor's outreach optics, Tap & Burger DTC closure, downtown Ikon relocation drive engagement as civic/entertainment coverage returns to summer baseline. Daily average 11.0 vs. prior period's 9.0 confirms momentum shift.

Wednesday's flat performance proved temporary relief — yesterday's single cancellation restarts the bleed. July's 23 days yield 39 new against 82 canceled for sustained −1.9/day pace, nearly triple YTD's +0.9/day. Recent week shows −17 net vs. prior period's −24, modest 29% improvement but still deeply negative. Acquisition engine stalled at 1-2 daily while cancellations run 3-5.
